nom: Origins Ginzing Glow-Boosting Brightening Face Mask

segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin leaning dry describes it as life-changing when used nightly as a moisturizer, though cautions that overuse can feel greasy under makeup.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin and allergies reports it works well for her with no issues, while another describes it triggering face and chest breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing themselves as aging or in their 70s report improved feel, glow, and no worsening of wrinkles.

concerns.aging: Reviewers with aging or mature skin report their skin feels better, fresher, and more revived, and one notes it does not enhance wrinkles; no dissent on this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers using it as a moisturizer report plump, hydrated, dewy skin; one reviewer states it did not feel moisturizing at all and did nothing for her skin.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the product helped fade acne scarring; another who hoped it would lessen dark spots saw no change after a month.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with a history of acne/scarring/texture reports it became a staple that improved her skin's glow and texture; several other reviewers report new breakouts or bumps after use, including one on medication for skin who does not normally break out.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the product is not greasy or sticky and absorbs into the skin, contrasting with other reviewers (not specified by skin type) who describe it as tacky, sticky, and sitting on top of the skin.

aspects.libelle: Marketed as mask but is a leave-on moisturizer
Sticky tacky texture that does not absorb

extraits.texte: this mask is AMAZINGGG!!! I got it for free as a gratis and I am obsessed! It is very expensive, but theres a LOT of product in one jar. I use it daily in the morning and have never had such glowey soft skin!!! I have struggled with terrible acne/scarring/texture for years, finally i found the perfect routine for my skin and this is a staple. I get compliments on how my skin glows! & i never get compliments on my skin so that shows me its working! It also smells amazinngggg! Seriously if your considering it, buy it! (especially if its on sale!, or if u have points and don't know what to get)

I was looking for a great hydrating mask and tried out the tester and fell in love with this formula. This mask is incredible. I have combo skin that leans more towards dry and this product has changed my life. I use it nightly as my night time moisturizer. It wears well under makeup too just be mindful and not use to much or it can feel a tad greasy. It absorbs well and works well with my serums (Estee Lauder Advanced Night Repai, Peach&Lily Lactic Acid Serum & Glass Skin Serum)

I used this one time and then broke out really bad over the following week, break outs are not the norm for me as I'm on medication for my skin. I also didn't like that you're supposed to leave it on.

extraits.titre: Must buy -Im on my 4th -obsessed with the Glow
extraits.texte: Must buy product. I am about to Purchase my 4th jar of this amazing glow boosting mask cream. I love the texture, love how the tiny beads pop on your face as you smooth this into your face. The consistency is beautiful. Lightweight. Doesn't sit heavy. The glow is very noticeable and I get compliments all the time. This smells amazing. Like semi vitamin c scent. Not overpowering or overwhelming at all. I have sensitive skin and allergies and this really works for me. Such an amazing product. This is my ride or die. If I was on a secret island with limited products I would take this one. The secrets officially out. Anyone scoring low on this item I don't understand why.
Very nice on the skin. Just rub it in, leave it on for a glowing shine. So nice for aging skin, does not enhance any wrinkles.

Omg how much do I LOVE the scent! It's like fresh-peeled tangerines right off the tree. Simply divine. I just wished I loved the product as much as the aroma. As others have mentioned, this is NOT a MASK. It's really a creamy serum that you leave on. I used it at night under my moisturizer and after a month, I didn't notice any changes in my skin tone. No lessening of dark spots. So disappointed.
i recieved this in my gratis and i love it! it helped my acne scarring and it leaves my skin with a healthy glow! not greasy or sticky you just have to let it dry and it absorbs into the skin
